summary.text: James Wolfe, also known as Ethan, is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 151, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Mike Cheokas (R) and independent Travis Lockhart.
A retired U.S. Air Force veteran, he lists affordability, education, and economic development as priorities in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Wolfe served in the U.S. Air Force from 1990 to 2020, graduated from Americus High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Strayer University in 1997, and earned a graduate degree from American Intercontinental University in 2004.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a 30-year retired military officer who wants to be accessible and transparent to constituents of District 151.
He said he would work on affordability, updating Georgia's Quality Basic Education funding formula, and job growth and increased wages.
